result.topic_en: The page ends a remark that a power series satisfying a linear differential equation with rational coefficients and having integer coefficients is an algebraic function, then sets the task of explaining why the discriminant of the spherical (Legendre) function equals the reciprocal of the discriminant of the quadratic form given by the integral of f(x)^2 from -1 to 1, via rational approximation of log((z+1)/(z-1)).
